name: CERT-In Directions 2022
description: Indian Computer Emergency Response Team directions under IT Act 2000 (s.70B) — mandatory for all service providers, intermediaries, data centres, government bodies in India.

controls.name: 6-hour incident reporting
controls.req: Report cybersecurity incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing or being notified, via certin.org.in portal.

controls.name: Incident categories in scope
controls.req: Report the mandatory categories: targeting, malware, ransomware, DoS/DDoS, website defacement, data breach, attacks on critical infrastructure.

controls.name: Format and fields for reports
controls.req: Submit in the specified format with: organization, contact, affected systems, IPs (public + private), CVE IDs, affected users, breach scope.

controls.name: Ransomware specific reporting
controls.req: For ransomware: include ransom demanded amount/currency, wallet/account details, communication channel with attackers.

controls.name: Log of all reported incidents
controls.req: Maintain an internal log of every incident reported to CERT-In, with timestamps and acknowledgements.

controls.name: Designated officer responsibilities
controls.req: Designate an officer responsible for CERT-In coordination and reporting; keep contact current.

controls.name: Logs retention — 180 days
controls.req: Maintain logs of all ICT systems (servers, network devices, endpoints) for a rolling 180 days.

controls.name: Log content requirements
controls.req: Logs must enable traceability: user activity, timestamps, source/destination IPs, ports, URLs, and transaction details.

controls.name: Log integrity
controls.req: Protect logs from alteration (write-once/WORM or equivalent); enable tamper-evident evidence.

controls.name: Log availability to CERT-In
controls.req: Provide access to logs to CERT-In or authorized entities for investigation on request.

controls.name: Time synchronization
controls.req: Synchronize system clocks (NTP) so logs from different devices correlate.

controls.name: Resume logging after outage
controls.req: Ensure logging resumes automatically after failure and gaps are documented.

controls.name: KYC records — 5 years
controls.req: Maintain validated customer/validator KYC records (name, address, ID type/number as per M-II) for 5 years.

controls.name: In-transit transaction records
controls.req: Preserve records of all transactions passing through systems (financial or otherwise) as specified.

controls.name: Secure storage of KYC data
controls.req: Store KYC information securely with access control and encryption (data processors to comply too).

controls.name: NAC deployment with CERT-In
controls.req: Network Access Control integration: interoperate with CERT-In systems (API/portal integration for automated exchange, blocking and coordination).

controls.name: Apply by dates
controls.req: Comply with direction deadlines (e.g. 28 days for logging from June 2022 direction), maintain evidence of readiness.

controls.name: Penalty exposure awareness
controls.req: Failure to comply is punishable under IT Act s.70B: imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to ₹1 lakh (and per-incident penalties).

controls.name: Review of obligations
controls.req: Track subsequent CERT-In updates/directions (2023–2025 amendments) and re-map controls annually.

source: CERT-In Directions under IT Act 2000 (Certified as per Govt of India Gazette 28 Apr 2022)
